The plugin registers itself against whatever jsPDF is already on the page, so
it must load *after* `jspdf.umd.min.js`, never in parallel with it.

## Consumers

| Tool | How it loads | What it does with it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Tools/011-image-to-pdf.html` | `<script src>` in head | the whole point of the tool — assembles the images into a PDF |
| `Tools/036-final_grade_checker.html` | injected on first Export PDF press, jsPDF then AutoTable | grade report table |
| `Tools/035-schedule-visualizer.html` | `<script src defer>` | "Export as PDF" |
| `Tools/046-blank-map-generator.html` | `<script src>` | "Save PDF" / "Save Worksheet PDF" — rasterizes the map to a canvas at the page format's exact physical dimensions so the PDF has a genuinely correct page size instead of relying on the browser's print dialog |

## Why 2.5.2 and not 2.5.1 or the 4.x line

Before Phase 1 the site carried both: 2.5.1 in four places and 2.5.2 in one
(`image-to-pdf/libs/`, which was orphaned — the tool actually loaded the 2.5.1
copy from its `lib/` folder). 2.5.2 is the last patch release on the 2.x line
and won: same constructor, same `addImage`/`addPage`/`text`/`output` calls all
four consumers use. The diff is seven commits — a unicode font fix and three
dependency security bumps (`dompurify`, `fflate`, `core-js`) — with no API
changes.

jsPDF has since moved to 3.x and 4.x. Skipped deliberately: two major version
jumps is a bigger change than tools with this little test coverage should
absorb sight unseen, and the 4.x UMD build is larger, so there is no size
argument either. Re-evaluate if something actually needs a 3.x/4.x feature.

## Updating

Replace the file, update the version and hash above, then exercise every
consumer in the table — for `035-schedule-visualizer` that is automated
(`node Tools/schedule/test/smoke.mjs` asserts a real PDF blob comes out); for
`011-image-to-pdf` run `node Tools/image-to-pdf/test/smoke.mjs`; the other two
have no test suite and need a PDF generated by hand. Then update
`PRECACHE_URLS`/`CACHE_VERSION` in `sw.js` if the filename changed.
